description: Ask for one podcast's RSS feed to be read again now rather than at its next scheduled check. Returns the show's current state and when the refresh was queued; new episodes show up in get_podcast_profile once the feed has been read (normally within minutes). Contact routes are re-checked separately, not by this call.

id.description: The show: a show_id from find_podcast_contacts, the RSS feed URL, or its podcast:guid.

name: refresh_podcast
title: Refresh Podcast
